title: Role-safe managed execution projections and fingerprinted reconciliation

phases.objective: Replace raw managed-run readback with role-safe projections, detect linked-state contradictions across all managed execution records, and provide a platform-admin-only, dry-run-first, SHA-256-confirmed transactional reconciliation boundary for unambiguous status drift.

e2e_journeys.actor: Authenticated tenant requester reading safe progress and platform admin inspecting or reconciling linked state
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Tenant users receive only safe progress and action guidance; admins receive safe evidence summaries and contradiction details; structural conflicts remain blocked; unambiguous run/binding/task status drift can be reconciled only with the exact current plan fingerprint and contradiction-free transactional readback.
steps: Load the managed workflow run, all bindings, linked task and parent tickets, approval holds, steps, and recent intervention events.
Reject non-managed runs and preserve the existing tenant/requester route authorization boundary.
Return a tenant projection that excludes execution context, authority snapshots, raw input/output/error payloads, raw idempotency keys, and raw event evidence.
Return an admin projection containing safe run/binding/task/parent/hold/step summaries, authority metadata, evidence hashes, allowlisted intervention fields, and a linked-state matrix.
Detect structural, relationship, tenant, approval, step, terminal, rollback, and status-drift contradictions.
Derive canonical state from completed rollback compensation, open or decided approval evidence, or workflow run status.
Generate deterministic repair actions only when every contradiction is status drift and no structural or ambiguous conflict exists.
Return dry-run actions, contradiction codes, SHA-256 plan fingerprint, and exact required confirmation without writes.
Require platform-admin authority and exact `RECONCILE_MANAGED_EXECUTION:<run_id>:<fingerprint>` confirmation before Apply.
Recalculate the plan under row locks, update only run/binding/task status fields, append immutable digest evidence, and roll back unless final readback has zero contradictions.
assertions: Tenant projection contains no execution_context_json, authority_snapshot_json, raw input_json, output_json, error_json, raw idempotency key, credential reference, or unknown event evidence.
Admin projection contains evidence SHA-256 values and allowlisted evidence summaries but no raw authority or execution payloads.

Missing or ambiguous binding/task/parent records, tenant/link mismatch, multiple open holds, terminal runs with active steps, completed runs with failed steps, and invalid rollback evidence block Apply.
Approved, rejected, expired, open, and supervisor approval evidence produces deterministic canonical states consistent with the managed decision service.
Completed compensation rollback preserves workflow run status cancelled and binding/task lifecycle rolled_back.
Dry-run is read-only and exposes the exact current plan fingerprint and confirmation string.
Tenant or non-admin reconciliation is rejected before database access.
A stale or incorrect confirmation cannot Apply.
Apply changes only workflow run status, binding lifecycle/customer/hold link, and task status/lifecycle/customer fields.
Apply writes one managed_execution_reconciled event containing plan and action digests, then requires zero-contradiction readback.
The oneOrNull Context Kernel suppression is limited to a function that returns a row only when candidate count equals one; zero and multiple candidates become explicit structural contradictions.
No approval decision, step status, relationship, tenant, authority, resource grant, provider, credential, external system, deployment, migration, registry, or Production mutation occurs.

phases.objective: Apply Migration 1043 and invoke the separately authorized Runtime Readiness contract before persistent tenant/admin projection validation.
Keep structural contradictions fail-closed while allowing only fingerprinted, deterministic run/binding/task status repair with transactional readback.
Exercise tenant projection, admin projection, dry-run, stale-confirmation rejection, blocking contradiction, and successful status reconciliation against a non-production tenant canary.
Verify exact deployed SHA, migration ledger, protected tenant/admin paths, reconciliation evidence, and final tenant-safe report before closing #4449.
